title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Hundred thousand Pesos, or So Much thereof as May Be Necessary, for the Relief of Indigent Sufferers From Fires, Earthquakes, Floods, Typhoons or Other Public Calamities.

text.en:
The funds for emergency service provided for in section 1-YY of Act Numbered Twenty-eight
hundred and seventy-five are hereby made available, in a sum not to exceed one hundred thousand pesos, for
the relief of indigent sufferers from fires, earthquakes, floods, typhoons or other public calamities that have
occurred, or may occur, in the Philippine Islands in the year nineteen hundred and twenty, including the
purchase and transportation of supplies to the territory or territories affected.

The money herein appropriated shall be distributed by the Secretary of the Interior in the
territory or territories affected, such distribution to be made pro rata in case there are two or more such
territories, and the sum or sums so alloted or prorated shall be disbursed in the discretion of the respective
provincial boards, subject to the approval of the Secretary of the Interior, for the purposes hereinbefore

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 24, 1920.
